defects.summary: The run summary counted rows the stream hides: a reasoning item closed without text and the host-internal reminder children. A one-answer run read "2 responses" (new-prefix). Re-proved on the fixed build: "1 response" for N, R and T.

A schedule captures the project of whichever conversation is active, but takes its workspace from the default folder. new-prefix was created while a conversation of another proof's project was active: its new conversation was attached to that project although it runs in the default folder. On the next boot that conversation resumed with the project posture (workspace: network not allowed), the folder's host kept that posture, and the next project-less scheduled run in the same folder was refused at start (new-blocked): "workspace host already uses sandbox posture workspace; restart the workspace host before starting this conversation with network". Every project-less conversation in that folder is refused the same way until the host restarts.

The run item count (Inspect run, items) takes every row without a turn id written during the run's window: R counts 6 items for its prompt and answer, because the other run's prompt and the queue notes fall in that window. Responses, preview, headline, next steps and issues are scoped.
Retry now does not advance the attempt counter: T read "Attempt 1 / 3" after its second dispatch, and Retry now stays offered after each non-retryable failure.

sideEffects: Six live turns. Test conversations left in place in <proof> folders. The first run's conversation stays attached to the parallel M0-05 proof's project B (the capture defect above). The user's posture, default folder and the two 27/09 schedules were restored; the AutomationWake trigger is back at its original time.
